## New or updated device

<!-- One device model per pull request. Never paste serial numbers, account ids,
e-mails, IP addresses, device names or captures from your home: describe them. -->

**Model:** <!-- product code (serial prefix), e.g. T8XXX, and marketing name -->
**Kind:** <!-- station / camera / sensor / lock / … -->
**Setup:** <!-- standalone, or paired to which station model -->
**Firmware:** <!-- main firmware of the device, and of its station if paired -->

### What this changes

- [ ] `DeviceModel` in `devices/types.py`
- [ ] `DeviceProfile` (capabilities, readable params) in `devices/capabilities.py`
- [ ] Settings file `devices/data/models/<PN>.json`, generated by `scripts/gen_models.py` (never hand-edited)
- [ ] Wire recipe in `devices/recipes.py` with a golden case
- [ ] Docs: `docs/reference/hardware-verification.md` row(s)

### Evidence

<!-- For each capability or setting you grade: what you did and what came back.
"verified" needs proof on hardware: a write that reads back, or a decoded capture.
Everything else stays "declared" (from the eufy app) or "unknown". -->

| Capability / setting | Grade | How it was proven |
|---|---|---|
| | verified / declared / unknown | e.g. write 3 → read back 3 → restored |

<summary>Output of <code>eufy-security coverage</code> and <code>status --raw</code> (serials masked)</summary>

```
eufy-security --redact-serials coverage
eufy-security --redact-serials status --raw
```

</details>

### Checklist

- [ ] [Add or verify a device](../docs/how-to/add-a-device.md) followed
- [ ] Every setting written on hardware was restored to its start value
- [ ] `uv run pytest tests/devices` passes
- [ ] `uv run python scripts/gen_device_matrix.py` run and `docs/reference/devices.md` committed
- [ ] `uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check && uv run mypy` clean
- [ ] No serials, account ids, addresses, device names or captures in the diff
